scope: recovered post-bind device lifecycle on both templates, emulator state mapping, and the getChargingState zero-packet finding

order: GATT connected (bleConnectState case 1; explicitly NOT success)
blePenState(...) populates device; if recording (state == 4099), syncFile(sessionId, 0, 0)

battery via pushed blePowerChange / bleChargingState callbacks (set up by setBatteryNotify/readBattery connect stages); getChargingState() exists in the public API but the template never calls it; syncTime() is never called by the template (connect-stage internal)
delayed getFileList 3000ms after connect (skipped unless Connected)

platform_differences: syncTime: iOS connect-stage internal (pre-bind) vs Android explicit post-connect call (pre-refresh)
post-bind refresh: iOS getState+getStorage vs Android getChargingState+getStorage (no getState)
battery: iOS notification-driven (blePowerChange) vs Android cache poll (getChargingState) fed by the same push path
recording-drift correction: iOS inline in blePenState (state 4099) vs Android explicit refreshRecordState()
file list: iOS via SyncManager on demand vs Android auto-refresh 3s after connect

getChargingState_finding.verdict: ZERO BLE packets: not implementable as an exchange
evidence: PlaudDeviceAgent.getChargingState()V bytecode: calls t3.b()Z (cached boolean) and t3.c()I (cached int), then listener.bleChargingState(boolean, int) synchronously
q.b()Z returns cached field d; q.c()I returns cached field c: pure field getters, no request construction, no z.a send
battery cache is fed by the device-pushed path: BattStatusRsp (p, opcode 9) is constructed inside the q$f device-event dispatcher (unsolicited notifications), not by any poll request
iOS template never calls getChargingState(); battery arrives via pushed blePowerChange/bleChargingState
getChargingState_finding.consequence: R1d implements no charging packet. The emulator state model covers lifecycle only; battery values remain future work pending the push-path trigger mapping.

transitions_not_implemented.BOUND: requires handshake success (bleBind status 0); RSA handshake out of scope
transitions_not_implemented.READY: requires post-bind refresh completion against a bound session; same blocker

emulator_state_model.boundary_assertion: bare command exchanges (R1a/R1b/R1c frames) must never advance past CONNECTED; tests assert this
